children: Beta Bionics announced FDA clearance of Mint, its rechargeable-free patch pump, and submitted a 510(k) for 3D Intelligence.
FDA cleared Mint, a two-piece reusable/disposable patch pump that never requires recharging and pairs with iOS/Android.
Full U.S. commercial launch of Mint expected Q1 2027; manufacturing capacity targeted at ≥1.5M disposable units in 2027.
Mint will launch exclusively via pharmacy channel; ~40% insured U.S. lives covered at launch, targeting ≥50% within first year.
Submitted 510(k) for 3D Intelligence, a three-experience insulin-dosing algorithm; iLet 3D expected by end-2026, Mint 3D with Mint launch, subject to FDA clearance.
Updated 2026 guidance: revenue narrowed to $121M–$126M reflecting up to $10M potential Q4 deferral; Mint expected to recapture deferred revenue in 2027.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Beta Bionics gets FDA clearance for Mint patch pump; submits 510(k) for 3D Intelligence, targets Q1 2027 launch
